signature: SUBROUTINE DLACN2( N, V, X, ISGN, EST, KASE, ISAVE )

params.name: v
params.reference: On the final return, $V = A \, W$, where $\mathrm{EST} = \operatorname{norm}(V)/\operatorname{norm}(W)$ (W is not returned).

params.name: x
params.reference:
On an intermediate return, X should be overwritten by

$$
A \, X, \quad\text{if}\quad \mathrm{KASE}=1
$$

$$
A^T \, X, \quad\text{if}\quad \mathrm{KASE}=2
$$

and DLACN2 must be re-called with all the other parameters unchanged.

params.name: est
params.reference: On entry with `KASE = 1` or 2 and `ISAVE(1) = 3`, `EST` should be unchanged from the previous call to DLACN2. On exit, `EST` is an estimate (a lower bound) for norm(A).

params.name: kase
params.reference: On the initial call to DLACN2, `KASE` should be 0. On an intermediate return, `KASE` will be 1 or 2, indicating whether X should be overwritten by $A \, X$ or $A^T \, X$. On the final return from DLACN2, `KASE` will again be 0.

params.name: ISAVE
params.reference: `ISAVE` is used to save variables between calls to DLACN2
